ski: Rain falls at most resorts through Saturday with under 1 in of new snow, then a colder system brings snow to the Cascades Sunday.
hike: Rain and cloud cover the mountains today, and skies clear in the Washington Cascades Saturday. Driest Saturday is at Mount St. Helens, dry with clear skies though models differ on high cloud, NWAC has no rating posted. Gusts reach 38 mph there.
